Ola Electric Opens First Dealer-Led Stores Across India

Ola Electric has launched its first dealer-led stores across seven Indian states, according to reports. This expansion follows the company's decision a month prior to open its sales and service network to partners. Ola Electric aims to establish over 500 dealerships in the coming quarters. The company's existing company-owned stores will transition into brand product experience centers. Following the announcement, Ola Electric shares saw a nearly 4% increase.
